```{r}
# Load readr library
# library(readr)
library(tidyverse)

#Load the dataset
data <- read_csv("public_transport_patronage.csv")
```

```{r}
# Check the data
glimpse(data)
```

## ANALYSIS 1 - DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS

```{r}
# Calculate descriptive statistics for each mode
data %>%
  gather(key = "Mode", value = "Value", `Metropolitan train`:`Regional bus`) %>%
  group_by(Mode) %>%
  summarise(
    "Mean" = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    "Median" = median(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    "Variance" = var(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    "Std. Deviation" = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
```

## ANALYSIS 2 - TIME SERIES TREND ANALYSIS

```{r}
# Create a new column with year-month value
data$YearMonth <- as.Date(paste(data$Year, data$Month, "1", sep = "-"), format = "%Y-%m-%d")

# Drop the original Year and Month columns
data_drop <- data %>% select(-`Year`, -`Month name`)

data_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(data_drop, cols = -YearMonth, names_to = "Mode", values_to = "Count")

ggplot(data_long, aes(x = YearMonth, y = Count, color = Mode)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Patronage Count by Mode",
       x = 'Year-Month',
       y = 'Patronage Count') +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Metropolitan train" = "blue",
    "Metropolitan tram" = "red",
    "Metropolitan bus" = "green",
    "Regional train" = "purple",
    "Regional coach" = "orange",
    "Regional bus" = "pink"
  )) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Mode")) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y-%m", date_breaks = "1 year")
```

## ANALYSIS 3 - TIME SERIES FORECASTING

```{r}
# Load libraries for time series analysis
library(stats)
library(forecast)

# Create a list of modes
modes <- c("Metropolitan train", "Metropolitan tram", "Metropolitan bus", "Regional train", "Regional coach", "Regional bus")

# Loop through the modes and generate forecasts and plots for each mode
for (mode in modes) {
  # Convert the data for the current mode to a time series object
  ts_data <- ts(data[[mode]], start = c(2018, 1), frequency = 12)

  # Fit an ARIMA model for the current mode
  arima_model <- auto.arima(ts_data)

  # Generate forecasts for the next 12 months for the current mode
  forecast_values <- forecast(arima_model, h = 12)

  # Create a plot for the forecast of the current mode
  # plot(forecast_values, xlab = "Year-Month", ylab = "Patronage Count", main = paste("ARIMA Forecast for", mode))
  
  # Save the plot as an image file if needed
  png(paste(mode, ".png", sep = ""), width = 1200, height = 800)
  plot(forecast_values, xlab = "Year-Month", ylab = "Patronage Count", main = paste("ARIMA Forecast for", mode))
  dev.off()
}

```
